decisions.reason: Independent challenge found explicit continuing blue.project development claims alongside attribution to walkingtoyou. The conflict does not establish own development, but makes categorical reseller-only exclusion unsafe. Preserve its map location while attribution remains unresolved.

Main read the current AI offering: Langdock is explicitly the platform; BeeBase configures agents and workflows for customers and provides setup and training. This is affirmative vendor implementation evidence rather than an inference from missing information.

Main read the company's description of its focus on Google Workspace and Cloud rollout, maintenance, support and training, plus selected vendor applications. These are the generic integration services excluded by the agreed criteria.

Main read the automation offering and full service navigation: the actual automation is Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Intune, Entra and Defender setup and operation. Its offering is managed customer IT infrastructure, not an attributed original technology.

Main read the agency page: its stated work is digital strategy and customer websites for SMEs and local businesses. Staff development skills alone do not establish a qualifying original platform or technology.

Main read the current complete managed-service catalogue and customer accounts: Azure migration, Microsoft365, security, backup, monitoring and infrastructure support. Its customers describe deployment and operation of vendor solutions, matching the excluded managed-IT scope.

Main read the current ECM product page: the company explicitly develops its own maintained SOAi software and interface modules alongside ELO integration. Third-party resale does not negate this attributable original technology.

Main read the STMZ case: the company maintains an original PHP platform and developed a new REST API in2025. This is concrete continuing software development, not solely a generic website or third-party configuration; no exclusive-IP requirement is imposed.

Main read the current offering: the public-sector implementation is explicitly built on its own guided-intake solution, alongside documented production systems. This supports maintained original technology rather than merely vendor setup, without requiring a standalone SaaS launch.

Main read the bws trackmaster case: the company explicitly co-developed the equipment-management platform and extended its mobile applications, with ongoing technical development. Partner development qualifies without asserting exclusive ownership or crediting Swisscom's underlying network technology.

Specialised physical EMC, radio and ESD testing infrastructure with accredited measurement facilities and prototype support fits Lab. This is not a general exemption for service businesses: the qualifying activity is operating technical laboratory infrastructure.
The official product page explicitly separates Swiss Infosec consulting and introduction from Swiss GRC software and operation. Do not credit a sister company's product to this entity.
The detailed offering describes customer-specific SAP extensions, interfaces, forms, maintenance and project management, not a maintained original product.

Main read the SmartCampus product page: CrossWorks explicitly develops this maintained school-management application, supported by the customer account of its continuing development. Its separate third-party KIM offering does not negate this original product. Withdraw the earlier exclusion recommendation.
UniVision is explicitly preconfigured SolarWinds. The separate uNimbus offering still needs main review before the entire company's exclusion is approved.
